modules.name: 01 Hero
heading: Omni CRM is
one system for every
customer touchpoint.
modules.lede: Omni CRM brings profiles, events, segments, flows, campaigns and a sales pipeline into one small service that Claude can operate through MCP. It is safe by default: nothing is sent until a real channel is connected, and its events can flow to Omni Tracker.
text:
Timeline_ 2 days
Scope_ 21 pages, 46 MCP tools

Project_ Omni CRM
Designed and built by_ Vignesh Murali

Omni CRM brings profiles, events, segments, flows, campaigns and a sales pipeline into one small service that Claude can operate through MCP. It is safe by default: nothing is sent until a real channel is connected, and its events can flow to Omni Tracker.
modules.alt: Omni CRM hero: one system for every customer touchpoint, with stats for 46 MCP tools, 21 web UI pages, 0 messages sent by default and 2 days of building.

modules.name: 02 At a glance
heading: One core.
Seven modules.
Two days.
modules.lede: A customer data platform, multichannel automation and a sales CRM that share one module contract.
text: A customer data platform, multichannel automation and a sales CRM that share one module contract.
Profiles and events, with segments, lists and scoring.
Flows and campaigns over email, SMS, push and WhatsApp.
Companies, deals, pipelines, tasks and custom objects.
Four channels, log transport by default
modules.alt: At a glance: one core and seven modules across customer data, journeys and campaigns, and a sales CRM.

modules.name: 03 Problem
heading: Data here.
Messages there.
Sales elsewhere.
modules.lede: Customer data, messaging and sales usually sit in separate tools, so nothing sees the whole customer.
text: Customer data, messaging and sales usually sit in separate tools, so nothing sees the whole customer.
Profiles and events in one tool, messaging in another
One profile per customer, with every event
A sales pipeline in a third
Flows and campaigns built on the same data
Nothing Claude could operate end to end
A sales pipeline beside the marketing
46 MCP tools so Claude can run it
modules.alt: The problem: data, messages and sales sit in separate tools; a before and after comparison with one Omni CRM workspace.

modules.name: 04 Process
heading: Core first.
Modules in parallel.
Claude in the loop.
modules.lede: A module contract meant each feature could be built and tested on its own.
text: A module contract meant each feature could be built and tested on its own.
MCP server: 46 tools, stdio and HTTP
Hardened public endpoints, then a security pass
A module contract every feature plugs into
Demo mode, Docker and a Vercel look-around
Messages are stored, not sent, until a channel is connected.
Public endpoints hardened, then a review.
modules.alt: Process in three phases, foundation, modules and operate and ship, plus four principles from core first to security as we go.

modules.name: 05 What we built
heading: What we built.
A core, seven modules,
one operator.
text: Node's built-in SQLite and HTTP server, with no runtime dependencies in the core.
Email, SMS, push and WhatsApp sit behind a log transport until a real one is connected.
Paste a link and get email, in-app or page HTML saved as a template.
modules.alt: What we built: a core with profiles and events surrounded by segments and lists, messaging, flows, analytics, sales pipeline and MCP with 46 tools.

modules.name: 06 Today
heading: What it does
today.
Working, and open.
text: ways to run: demo, Docker, Vercel look-around
The Docker image has not been built in CI yet, and the Vercel copy is a demo only: its data resets and scheduled sends do not run there.
modules.alt: Result today: 46 MCP tools, 21 UI pages, 0 runtime dependencies in the core and 3 ways to run, with a note on work in progress.
